privileged_info_for_vlm: The task is successful if a Financial Report (PA_Report) named 'GP Board Report' exists. It must be linked to a Line Set (PA_ReportLineSet) named 'Gross Profit Analysis' and a Column Set (PA_ReportColumnSet) named 'Current Period Analysis'. The Line Set must contain three lines: 'Total Revenue' (Segment Value), 'Total COGS' (Segment Value), and 'Gross Profit' (Calculation). The Column Set must contain a column 'Period Actual' with type 'Period Balance'.
